description:
Move assert_live_fixture, assert_noul_fixture, and all 24 fixture test cases (DevOps, Billing, Security, DataEng, Refund, Flags, Oncall, ArduPilot Battery/EKF/Vibe, and Ping across TypeSafe and OpenRouter) out of src/main.rs into a dedicated integration test target at tests/fixtures.rs.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. tests/fixtures.rs exists and imports types, build_decision_value, and validate_request from the jeb library crate.
2. All 24 live fixture tests execute under cargo test --test fixtures and validate both request schema and response summary output.
3. No fixture test functions or include_str!("../fixtures/...") calls remain in src/main.rs.
4. Repetitive 3-question and noul fixture assertions are cleanly structured (table-driven or concise helper macro) without losing individual test granularity.

agent: gemini-4-argon (antigravity)
title: Move live provider fixture tests to tests/fixtures.rs
